steps.title: Add Lysis Buffer and Ethanol
steps.instruction: After pelleting the remaining material, remove the supernatant, then add Buffer AL and ethanol to the pellet.

steps.title: Transfer to Spin Column
steps.instruction: Transfer the resulting solution to a DNeasy Mini spin column (Qiagen, Hilden, DE).

steps.title: Centrifuge to Bind DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the spin column at 8000 rpm (duration as per kit instructions) to allow DNA binding.

steps.title: Incubate with Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with elution Buffer AE for 20 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Elute DNA by Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA by centrifuging the column at 8000 rpm for 1 minute.
